__tool__.instructions: Which action best advances `instructions`, given `state` and `previous_actions`?

criteria.open_ticket: Opens the next ticket of `state.queue` that has not been looked at yet, so that its body can be read and handled. Use it when the open ticket needs nothing more.
criteria.assign: Assigns the open ticket (`state.open_ticket`), which has no team yet, to a team.
criteria.set_status: Sets the status of the open ticket (`state.open_ticket`), for instance closes it. A ticket is a duplicate only when its own body says it repeats another ticket, for instance 'Duplicate of ticket 5'; a ticket nobody repeats is not a duplicate.
criteria.tag: Adds one tag to the open ticket (`state.open_ticket`). Use it only when `instructions` ask for tags.

open_ticket.ticket.instructions: Which ticket of `state.queue` should be looked at next to carry out `instructions`?

assign.team.instructions: Which team should the ticket in `state.open_ticket` go to to carry out `instructions`?

criteria.billing: payments, charges, refunds, subscriptions, invoices and VAT
criteria.technical: bugs, crashes and errors of the product
criteria.general: anything else, such as how-to questions

assign.instructed.instructions: Is the ticket in `state.open_ticket` one of the tickets that `instructions` say to send to a team?

criteria.true: `instructions` name a kind of ticket and a team, and this ticket is of that kind
criteria.false: `instructions` say nothing about sending a ticket of this kind to a team

set_status.status.instructions: Which status should the ticket in `state.open_ticket` have to carry out `instructions`?

criteria.pending: the ticket waits for the customer
criteria.closed: the ticket is done with: it repeats another ticket

set_status.repeats_another.instructions: Does the body of `state.open_ticket` say that this ticket repeats, or is a duplicate of, another ticket?

criteria.true: The body names another ticket it duplicates, for instance 'Duplicate of ticket 5'
criteria.false: The body describes a problem or a request and does not say it repeats another ticket

tag.tag.instructions: Which tag should be added to the ticket in `state.open_ticket` to carry out `instructions`?

criteria.urgent: the customer cannot work until it is fixed
criteria.vip: the customer is a key account
